text: Fixed in `middleware/proxy.go`: the proxy middleware panicked when the balancer had no targets (`randomBalancer.Next` called `rand.Intn(0)`, `roundRobinBalancer.Next` did `% uint32(0)`). Both `Next` methods now return nil for an empty target list, and the middleware returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` (HTTP 503) instead of panicking. Verified: `go build ./...`, `go vet`, and the full `go test ./...` suite pass (including all pre-existing proxy tests), and a temporary test with `NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{})` / `NewRandomBalancer(nil)` now gets 503 (temp test removed afterwards; only proxy.go is modified).
Working on it: router.go fix in progress (no-routable-path handling), ETA ~4 min.
Working on it: context.go Scheme() now ignores invalid X-Forwarded-Proto/Protocol/Url-Scheme values and falls back to http, ETA ~4 min.
Working on it: bind.go map binding (map[string][]string and other element kinds), ETA ~4 min.
Working on it: group.go multiple-groups-same-path middleware handling, ETA ~5 min.
Working on it: compress.go empty-response gzip handling (Content-Encoding must be dropped for empty bodies), ETA ~5 min.
